alt-signal-from-cross-reactivity: The fluorescence attributed to iGABASnFR2 comes from compounds that resemble GABA rather than from GABA itself.
crystal-structure-pdb-9d57: The crystal structure of iGABASnFR2, showing its binding pocket and cpGFP arrangement, is deposited in the Protein Data Bank.
hypothesis-improved-sensor-enables-new-b: A sufficiently sensitive GABA sensor enables measurements iGABASnFR1 cannot make at all, rather than cleaner versions of old ones.
hypothesis-saturation-mutagenesis-yields: Mutating a handful of residues around iGABASnFR1's GABA-binding pocket and cpGFP linkers yields a far better sensor without losing selectivity.
igabasnfr2-13fold-expression-increase: iGABASnFR2 produces about thirteen times as many responding pixels as iGABASnFR1, reflecting better sensitivity and better membrane trafficking.
igabasnfr2-2p-compatible: iGABASnFR2 works under two-photon imaging, and both new variants are less sensitive to pH than iGABASnFR1.
igabasnfr2-cpgfp-rigid-on-gaba-binding: GABA binding closes iGABASnFR2's binding lobes but leaves the fluorescent cpGFP domain almost unmoved, unlike GCaMP with calcium.
igabasnfr2-fourfold-sensitivity-gain: iGABASnFR2 gives a roughly fourfold larger fluorescence change than iGABASnFR1 for the same stimulation in cultured neurons.
igabasnfr2-gaba-selective-specificity: iGABASnFR2 responds to GABA and not to structurally similar compounds, none of which block or distort its GABA response.
igabasnfr2-invivo-barrel-cortex: iGABASnFR2 detects GABA spilling into the extracellular space of mouse barrel cortex when the whiskers are stimulated.
igabasnfr2-kinetics-rise-decay: iGABASnFR2 rises faster and decays more slowly than iGABASnFR1, while the negative-going variant rises more slowly than both.
igabasnfr2-oncell-affinity-sevenfold: On the neuron surface iGABASnFR2 binds GABA about seven times more tightly than iGABASnFR1, still above resting GABA levels.
igabasnfr2-retina-direction-selectivity: iGABASnFR2 shows that starburst amacrine cells release GABA differently depending on motion direction, which iGABASnFR1 could not resolve.
igabasnfr2-single-bouton-hippocampus: iGABASnFR2 detects GABA released from single hippocampal interneuron boutons, where iGABASnFR1 gave no signal at all.
igabasnfr2-single-exponential-kinetics: iGABASnFR2 and its negative-going variant bind GABA in one fast step, while iGABASnFR1 binds in two slower phases.
igabasnfr2n-negative-going-variant: A variant called iGABASnFR2n dims rather than brightens when GABA binds, and is also far better expressed than iGABASnFR1.
mutagenesis-3947-variants-screened: A screen of nearly 4,000 variants at 39 sites yielded 93 more responsive than iGABASnFR1 and 22 better in both response and expression.
prediction-improved-sensor-enables-new-m: iGABASnFR2 should beat iGABASnFR1 at single boutons, at single-trial direction selectivity in retina, and at whisker-evoked GABA in the living brain.
prediction-screen-yields-multiple-improv: The screen should yield several variants beating iGABASnFR1 on response, at least one also better expressed, and some behaving in new ways.
scope-sensor-engineering-paper: All tests use cultured neurons, purified protein, retina, hippocampal slice and mouse cortex, not awake or non-mammalian preparations.
screening-scope-wet-lab-only: The performance claims rest on bench measurements that cannot be reproduced from the deposited code and data, which only redraw the figures.
